criteria: A complete, timed 1 hour 30 minute, 100-mark paper attempted at the learner's tier -- one non-calculator and one calculator paper, ideally, since real candidates sit three papers in total
Working is shown throughout so method marks would genuinely be awarded, not just final answers
Performance holds up across every content strand under mixed, non-sequential question order (unlike stage tests, which isolate one topic at a time)
No single strand (number, algebra, graphs, geometry and measures, probability, statistics) collapses when questions are not sign-posted by topic
exam_rubric.pass_threshold: Foundation tier: performance consistent with grade 4-5 (a standard/strong pass) across a full paper. Higher tier: performance consistent with grade 6-7. OCR sets exact grade boundaries per series rather than a fixed mark table, so this is a standard/consistency judgement, not a single number.
